title: CallerIdType
description:
* `DEFAULT_CLID` - Caller ID is the default configured caller ID.
 * `ADDITIONAL_CLID` - Caller ID is an additional external caller ID phone number available for the user.
 * `CALL_QUEUE` - Caller ID is associated with a call queue.
 * `HUNT_GROUP` - Caller ID is associated with a hunt group.
